meta.note: Every summary_text below is the verbatim console output of print(summary(fit), digits = 3) on a model fitted by this script. Expected values are read off the fitted model object and asserted to equal the printed text.

gauss.label: Healthy linear model
gauss.blurb: A well behaved gaussian fit: every Rhat sits at 1.00 and n_eff is in the thousands. This is what a trustworthy fit looks like.
gauss.r_call:
library(rstanarm)
fit <- stan_glm(mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars, seed = 1234)
print(summary(fit), digits = 3)

logit.label: Logistic regression
logit.blurb: The wells example from the rstanarm documentation. Coefficients are on the log-odds scale, so they need exponentiating before they mean anything.
logit.r_call:
library(rstanarm)
data(wells)
wells$dist100 <- wells$dist / 100
fit <- stan_glm(switch ~ dist100 + arsenic, data = wells,
                family = binomial(link = "logit"), seed = 4321)
print(summary(fit), digits = 3)

weak.label: Too few iterations
weak.blurb: The same kind of model run for 50 iterations instead of 2000. The Rhat and n_eff columns are what a fit you must not report looks like.
weak.r_call:
library(rstanarm)
# iter = 50 is deliberately far too short
fit <- stan_glm(mpg ~ wt + hp + disp + drat, data = mtcars,
                chains = 4, iter = 50, seed = 99)
print(summary(fit), digits = 3)

mlm.label: Multilevel model
mlm.blurb: A varying intercept per cylinder count. Adds the b[] group offsets and the Sigma[] variance row that only multilevel output carries.
mlm.r_call:
library(rstanarm)
fit <- stan_glmer(mpg ~ wt + (1 | cyl), data = mtcars, seed = 2024)
print(summary(fit), digits = 3)

diverge.label: Divergent transitions
diverge.blurb: The same multilevel model with adapt_delta dialled down to 0.40. The sampler genuinely diverges, and R's own warnings are pasted underneath the summary.
diverge.r_call:
library(rstanarm)
# adapt_delta = 0.40 is deliberately far too low
fit <- stan_glmer(mpg ~ wt + (1 | cyl), data = mtcars, chains = 2,
                  iter = 800, seed = 5, adapt_delta = 0.40)
print(summary(fit), digits = 3)
